prompt_suffix.flower: In this image each particle has been replaced by a flower emoji on a white background; treat every flower as one particle and box it.
prompt_suffix.car: In this image each particle has been replaced by a car emoji on a white background; treat every car as one particle and box it.
prompt_suffix.car_standalone: In this image the scan has been redrawn as a grid of small car emoji on a white background. Each car is one small patch of the scan: the more opaque (darker red) a car, the stronger the element signal in that patch; faint or invisible cars are background. A particle is a cluster of neighbouring opaque cars: draw ONE box around each cluster, not around each car.
